source: Original pinned assembly metadata and unchanged fields in both frozen copies; no original code execution

findings.rule: Both wrappers select global Actor table. Actor and field names are StringToTableIndex keys. Missing/non-table Actor or actor subtable, null or singleton LuaNil field returns NoResult. This is direct LuaTable access, not building/executing a Lua expression.

findings.locator: actor-field-lookup.il StringToTableIndex IL_0000..0091/DoubleQuotesToSingle IL_0000..003c/SpacesToUnderscores IL_0000..0018; slash-setting-uses.il
findings.rule: Null/empty key -> empty. Replace double quote with underscore BEFORE the misleadingly named DoubleQuotesToSingle; that helper escapes any remaining double quote to backslash-quote, LF to literal backslash-n and removes CR. Then ASCII space, hyphen and parentheses -> underscore; slash -> underscore only when replaceSlashWithUnderscore true. Case, apostrophe, existing backslash and tabs are retained. The static constructor sets slash replacement true; the own-assembly use scan sees no other writer. External/reflection mutation is not excluded. Raw byte output preserves CR versus LF.

Default means IsNullOrEmpty(language), not an English/en alias. Default or empty field converts the unsuffixed field; otherwise append underscore plus exact language then convert the whole field. Name/Display Name suffixes are language keys; no runtime language is inferred or mapped here. Static/reset defaults are empty language and useDefaultIfUndefined=true; actual language/flags remain unknown.

First read the localized field. Only when UseDefaultIfUndefined is true, null result luaValue, any LuaNil instance, or LuaString with null/empty Text retries the base field. Literal LuaString("nil"), whitespace string, boolean false and numeric zero do NOT trigger this table-level fallback. There is no recursive or next-language fallback in this body.

findings.locator: lua-result-string.il; lua-environment.il get_NoResult/.cctor; lua-string-values.il/lua-string-set.il; lua-nil-values.il; prior bio-participant-resolution/character-resolution.il GetLocalizedDisplayNameInDatabase
findings.rule: NoResult holds a null luaValue; asString returns empty for absent value and otherwise Object.ToString. LuaString ToString returns Text unchanged; LuaNil ToString returns exact lowercase nil. CharacterInfo helper reads localized Display Name, then localized Name, then original passed database name; each display fallback rejects null/empty/exact case-sensitive nil, not whitespace/NIL. It then calls ParseCode. Literal nil may therefore fail at this consumer even though it did not activate localized-table fallback.

Component path first chooses its actor string or Unity object name. It reads that actor table's unlocalized Name, converts the result asString, and passes THAT value as the actor-name input to GetLocalizedDisplayNameInDatabase. If Lua Name changes, this is potentially another actor-table key; it is not necessarily the original component actor key. A nonempty helper result replaces the initial component name. Exact [lua/[var trigger full Parse with masterDatabase emphasisSettings after the helper already ParseCode'd. No actual component/name/language/override accepted.

findings.locator: parse-code.il IL_0000..0027; existing bio-subtitle-formatting source-trace and helpers
findings.rule: ParseCode maps null to empty and, only if any [ exists, calls ReplaceLuaTags then ReplaceVarTags. It does not run full emphasis/picture/flags parsing. Reuse phase80 regex/evaluator/order/100-iteration/caught-failure limits; inserted values can affect later parsing. No Lua expression or dynamic Parse was executed. All sixteen original selected Name values lack [.

Lua static/reset creates a global environment and null NoResult. DialogueLua static ctor sets slash=true then initializes ChatMapper variables and registers functions; its separate runtime reset body schedules registration but does not itself call InitializeChatMapperVariables. InitializeChatMapperVariables executes a script resetting Actor and other tables. AddChatMapperVariables returns on null database, adds Actor/Item/Location/variables/conversations, then executes nonempty database.globalUserScript. Original calls are inspected, not executed; reset order and actual populated environment are unaccepted.

In own-assembly calls, DatabaseManager.Add resets tables when the loaded database list is empty, merges supplied DB into m_masterDatabase, passes m_masterDatabase plus the pre-add loaded list to AddChatMapperVariables, then appends supplied DB to loaded list. Null/already-loaded input does nothing. Clear resets tables before clearing master/list. The ctor creates master and invokes defaultDatabase setter; that setter/controller initialization/merge implementation are next dependencies, not proof this candidate was live or loaded.

findings.locator: actor-table-initialization.il AddToTable IL_0000..00db/GetFieldLuaValue IL_0000..006c; existing-actor-keys.il; field-types.il; lua-table-access.il
findings.rule: AddToTable requires existing Lua table, obtains exact original asset Names in loaded databases, skips those existing raw names, otherwise builds a fresh actor subtable under converted Asset.Name. It converts EVERY field title and adds GetFieldLuaValue in source order. Text0/Files3/Localization4/default become LuaString of field.value, not key-converted/escaped values; Number1/Actor5/Item6/Location7 become numbers, Boolean2 boolean, null field LuaNil. Initial list empty/null uses AddRaw, otherwise SetKeyValue. String AddRaw overwrites matching cached keys; SetKeyValue supports nil removal/dictionary writes; selection is not duplicate rejection. LuaTable GetValue can invoke __index table/function on a missing key; real metatables are not assumed absent in live play.

Only IDs 1,2,3,4,5,6,8,9,10,11,13,14,15,16,25,31. Both copies agree: each has one Text0 Name and no base Display Name or normalized Name_/Display_Name_ fields. Actor keys remain original names, unique within this sixteen-actor set. Exact BG row/dbName/nameplate spans retained separately. Conditional post-add/no-mutation LuaString Name equals plugin Name; 64 supplied empty/ru and fallback-flag combinations per copy retain it at CharacterInfo helper, not actual displayed name. BGDatabase NameplateName is not inserted by this plugin initialization. Later custom nameplate/introduced/player/scene paths remain separate.

coverageLimits: No actual current Lua environment, table/metatable, language, reset/loading order, save restore, callback or runtime mutation accepted.
Original plugin ID/Name, Actor Lua key/value, localized Display Name, CharacterInfo.Name, BGDatabase dbName/NameplateName and live Transform are distinct.
Only sixteen original actor field sets are selected; no claim of all39 actor-key collision coverage.
Python supplied controls replace Lua/.NET/Unity, culture, lifecycle, metatable and renderer. They are not runtime or editorial tests.
No translations, target overlays, images, game/GUI/preview or Git/index/branch mutations.
No native SendMessage, actual Subtitle delivery/rendering/BIO/reachability, complete source/special-scene, final semantic/independent diff/delta/fonts/resources/package/delivery acceptance.
